items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: their mother, Henry McCall's mother played piano.

ctx.x: Well, I'm not real sure I know just where you lived when you moved down. You said your mother worked uptown. Did you live there with her or was it?

Well, we lived there when we first went to New Orleans. Yes. We stayed on premises there. See, there was big houses like the Wilmans and them, they had a nice little- You lived there too then? Yeah, lived there with my mother, yeah. And then later when you were late- See, my brother was already in New Orleans. My brother was the way for the people while we was raised. See, the people while we were raised, we can get back to that too. Yes. The people while we were raised, was McCalls. And while we, I think they…
